detailZones.title: Garden layout
detailZones.description: Complete fenced garden with the central gravel path, timber gate and individual stepping stones

detailZones.title: Greenhouse
detailZones.description: Glass growing house with a vented roof, framed door, staging bench, pots and tomato vines

detailZones.title: Raised beds
detailZones.description: Two timber-edged beds with visible soil, leafy vegetables, carrots and a bamboo bean support

detailZones.title: Potting bench
detailZones.description: Wooden workbench with a watering can, seedling tray, hand tools, gloves and a soil sack

detailZones.title: Water and irrigation
detailZones.description: Rainwater station with a barrel, downspout, brass tap, hoses, reel, nozzle and drip tubing

detailZones.title: Compost and soil
detailZones.description: Open timber compost station beside a wheelbarrow and three distinct long-handled garden tools

detailZones.title: Pollinator border
detailZones.description: Dense flowering foreground with sunflowers, lavender, coneflowers and one visible butterfly
